# Conversion Copywriting

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @guia-matthieu (ClawFu). Discovered via skills.sh. A research-first copywriting system based on Joanna Wiebe's Copyhackers methodology: start from customer language (Voice of Customer research), follow a systematic production workflow for landing pages, emails, and sales pages, validate copy before launch, and measure what works — turning blank-page panic into data-backed decisions you can defend. Honest notes: a process discipline, not a magic formula — the quality of the copy still depends on the research you actually do; its strength is B2B/SaaS-style conversion copy, creative brand writing is a different craft; validation and testing take real time and traffic, which small sites may lack. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
